description_excerpt: Job Description - Troubleshoot machine to ensure continuous production time. - Support other team members to meet output target as well as scrap rate. - Monitor and report machines’ status, including: safety guarding, productivity, etc. to team lead and maintenance team to provide proper corrective action. Sustain 5S at working area. - Support Engineer to setup and test new items, trial run. - Collecting data of production and report the key highlight of production efficency, quality trend, cost consuming. - Coordinate with other team to process sample, urgent orders, deploy new product,…
